First release with a ready-to-run Windows build. No Node.js or git needed.

**Install**

1. Download `soundpad-rpc-v1.0.0-win-x64.zip` below and unpack it anywhere.
2. Create a Discord application named **Soundpad** in the [Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications) and copy its Application ID. Optionally upload `assets/logo.png` as an Art Asset named `soundpad`.
3. Run `windows\run-console.cmd` once, paste the ID into `config.json` as `client_id`, run it again.
4. Run `windows\install-autostart.cmd` to start it hidden with Windows.

Full guide: [README](https://github.com/why4m3/soundpad-rpc#installation).

**What it does**

- Shows "Listening to Soundpad" in Discord with the sound title, category and a live progress bar.
- Handles pause, seek, switching sounds and stop; reconnects when Soundpad or Discord restarts.
- Single `soundpad-rpc.exe`, no dependencies, practically no CPU usage.

SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher because the exe is not code-signed: **More info → Run anyway**. The exe is built by GitHub Actions from this tag; `.sha256` has the checksum.

**Русский.** Первая версия с готовой сборкой под Windows, Node.js не нужен. Скачайте zip ниже, распакуйте, создайте приложение Soundpad в Discord Developer Portal, вставьте его ID в `config.json` и запустите `windows\run-console.cmd`. Подробно в [README на русском](https://github.com/why4m3/soundpad-rpc/blob/main/README.ru.md#установка).
